detail: CONSERVE HOST_BEAT_TO_REQUEST owner=wb_port lost=4 of=24 from=wb to=req observed=20 | Every host beat the port accepts (wb_cyc_i && wb_stb_i && !wb_stall_o) becomes exactly one request presented to and taken by the command queue (req_valid && req_ready). A port that accepts a beat it cannot deliver has lost a host access: a write is acknowledged and lost, a read is never answered. The port must either stall the beat or hold the request until the queue takes it.

CONSERVE READ_CMD_TO_RESPONSE owner=data_path lost=5 of=12 from=dp_cmd.read to=dp_rd_rsp observed=7 | Every RD command the data path is told about (cmd_rd_valid) yields exactly one read response (rd_rsp_valid), whatever the spacing between RD commands: the spec allows CAS-to-CAS at tCCD, so the capture must pipeline or the command generator must be held, not the command dropped.
